svg.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.title: Contribution city
svg.desc: Contribution city: an isometric night skyline with one building per day of the last year, taller and brighter for busier days. 6,252 contributions, busiest day September 8 with 268.
